title: A fresh install opens on the four-step first-run page and walks steps 1 to 3
description: A real browser on the built dashboard opens a seeded fresh install at its root and lands on the first-run page, then walks steps 1 to 3 with a stub Builder account: step 1 repository connection (refused, then ticked with the repository name), step 2 live model check failing with the provider's sentence, then passing and ticked with the Builder name and registered model id, and step 3 current with its terminal equivalent.
